sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: I was defeated by... basic clothing maintenance.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Thank you... and I'm really sorry.
sprite_sequence.label: holding_back_tears

sprite_sequence.text: I don't deserve a reward for this.

sprite_sequence.text: If even breakfast gave up... maybe I can stop panicking for one second.

sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

gpt.rationale: The sequence stays mostly subdued and inward—uneasy, tearful, faint-smiling fits an introvert—but repeated exasperated sprites make her frustration read a bit more outward than the personality suggests.

claude.rationale: Sprites consistently favor subtle, restrained expressions (uneasy_confused, holding_back_tears, faint_smile) that align with introversion, though exasperated appears slightly too vocally emphatic for a reserved character; emotional progression tracks the arc from frustration through despair to quiet acceptance with only minor mismatches.
